topic: Advanced React Hooks and Component Patterns
learningObjectives: Use React hooks to manage component state and side effects.
Identify appropriate hooks for common application scenarios.
Apply reusable component patterns to organize frontend logic.

activities.title: Hooks Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of common React hooks.

content.concept: React hooks such as useState and useEffect provide state and side-effect capabilities to functional components.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Hook Selector Lab
activities.instruction: Choose the appropriate hook for each scenario.

content.concept: Different hooks solve different problems, such as state management, side effects, references, and memoization.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Effect Execution Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange when an effect runs and cleans up.

content.concept: The dependency array controls when an effect is evaluated, while cleanup handles resources from previous effects.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Reusable Hook Builder
activities.instruction: Compose a custom hook from reusable logic.

content.concept: Custom hooks extract reusable stateful logic so multiple components can share behavior.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
